title: District Commission or State Commission or National Commission

content.scenario: A consumer dispute was settled by mediation. The District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission must pass a suitable order recording the settlement and dispose of the matter.
content.outcome: The District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission must pass a suitable order recording the settlement and dispose of the matter within seven days of the receipt of the settlement report.

user_queries: What is the role of the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission in settling a consumer dispute?
How does the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission pass a suitable order?
What is the time limit for passing a suitable order after receiving the settlement report?
